title: Security Bounds for Identical Round Keys
summary: Information-theoretic security bounds are known for independent round keys; proving corresponding bounds when all round keys are identical remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the $t$-round key-alternating construction, information-theoretic security bounds are known under the assumption that the round keys are independent; the unresolved task is to establish corresponding bounds when every round key is identical.

scope.domain: Information-theoretic security analysis of key-alternating ciphers.
assumptions: The known security bounds assume independent round keys.
parameters: t: number of rounds in the key-alternating construction
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish corresponding information-theoretic security bounds when every round key is identical.

citations.label: Key-Alternating Ciphers in a Provable Setting: Encryption Using a Small Number of Public Permutations - (Extended Abstract)

progress.summary: The paper gives security bounds under independent round keys and explicitly presents the identical-round-key case as a desirable extension for aesthetic and practical reasons.
citation_labels: Andrey Bogdanov et al., Key-Alternating Ciphers in a Provable Setting: Encryption Using a Small Number of Public Permutations - (Extended Abstract)
